name: Kinga Kollár - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the EU’s approach to corporate tax policy in a changing international environment
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU should handle company tax. It says the global minimum tax on big multinationals is applied unevenly, and that a new deal exempting United States-based companies puts European firms at a disadvantage. It asks the European Commission to study this and propose fixes, to simplify tax reporting, and to keep pushing for worldwide cooperation on taxing digital companies. The report is not a law and changes nothing by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Large multinational companies, especially European ones competing with United States firms.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
